_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: distributions — not all randomness is flat

voltage.why: entropy as the MEASURE of disorder — H = -Σ p log p turns chaos into a number in bits; disorder becomes quantity, the thing you can read off a gauge
the seed as determinism-inside-chance — same seed, same 'random' world, always; fate wearing the mask of freedom, the fork where chance is exposed as scripted
pseudo-random as the machine's honesty about its own fakery — crank the LCG by hand and watch 'randomness' fall out of pure arithmetic; the machine confesses it cannot flip a real coin
the irreducible enters through the BODY — your controller jitter, grip, head-turn become the only true noise; randomness as the uncomputable remainder the machine must borrow from the world
the queer core made archive — RAND's 1955 table of a million 'random' digits, chance frozen into a printed book; the irreducible captured, bound, and sold, and still it never repeats
